fitzgen opened PR #15318 from fitzgen:main-backport-f621ac0225 to bytecodealliance:main:

When an operation was actually in progress cancellation incorrectly didn't check whether the handle being provide was either the read or the write handle, meaning that the wrong handle could be used which could later lead to an inconsistent state.
